full_page.content:
1957 New Years Greetings and Congratulations,
To Very Rev. Fr. Provincial, Gerald O.F.M. Cap. :
Very Rev. Dear -- Fr. Provincial:
That the Good God and Our Blessed Mother Mary Immaculate, be with you in all your ways and undertakings during the coming year - and ever after - I am hereby promising to offer a "Free Mass and 31 holy Rosaries this coming Month.
Filius Tuus in Corde Jesu and S. Francis
Solanus
1957, March 8
3/8/57 Glory Be to God! Peace to Men.
Dear Very Rev. Father Provincial. Name-day Congratulatory Greetings!
Together with all the above implies I am offering a novena of rosaries and a Free Mass for personal guidance.
Personal Guidance of
V. Rev. F. Provincial - Gerald O.F.M. Cap.
Filius Tuus - Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
